verdict.rationale: Typesense's own pages say it offers built-in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and native LLM integrations, and semantic and hybrid vector search support retrieval over indexes. The evidence comes only from marketing comparison pages, not an API reference describing a conversational or answer endpoint. Missing for 10: documented RAG/conversation API reference (endpoints, parameters, response format), details on conversation history or multi-turn support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can power RAG and conversational answers on top of my indexes with documented retrieval or answer APIs

citations.quote: It also offers native integrations with LLMs of your choice to enable Natural Language Search and built-in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
along with type validation, stable JOINs and nested filters, Natural Language Search, and RAG.
Typesense combines typo-tolerant keyword search with direct vector search, hybrid search, semantic search, and geo search.
